uiComponents.scope: Declared major shared UI APIs; direct source calls only. Dynamic aliases/attribute wiring and undiscovered components require source review. Add the component being changed before proceeding; do not wait for a whole-application inventory. Candidate-list capability also tracks semantic surfaces, shared wording ownership and a real cross-entry regression; manually search same-purpose independent implementations beyond direct references.

components.name: 重ね方の選択
surfaces: 探すの撮影条件・見え方の条件編集
components.contract: 部位と全体の通過を共通に選択。縁・中心の入力なし。旧明示条件は操作まで保持し説明、部位の選び直しで現行通過へ。保存はcallerのdraft/sessionが所有。

components.name: 共通日時バー
components.contract: 同じ日時バーの配置・DOM・所有権を維持。表示投影は共通、時刻状態は各host。

components.name: 共通カレンダー
components.contract: 暦日選択・親画面の寿命・権限/取消を共通管理。呼出元の時刻を確定。

components.name: 共通地図
components.contract: 同じ地図部品の独立instanceを使用。表示・投影・panを再利用し選択値/保存を各hostへ渡す。見え方の移動は登録形状/確認した歩道だけ、同梱不足時の補完も取得境界内。確定とUndoの有効状態/44px/枠を揃え、草稿も戻せ、確定後は同じUndo DOMを地図の外へ保持する。失敗後の再取得と旧後着を検証する。

components.name: 見え方の共有気象設定DOM
surfaces: 探す・見え方の再構築と往復
components.contract: 共有気象設定をcanvas/状態表示の置換前に外へ保持し、次の描画で同じDOMを戻す。値・listener・計算状態を複写しない。

components.name: 記録した撮影地点の候補一覧
surfaces: NOTES 重なる日（確定/確認中）
記録地点詳細の線/範囲の重なる日
components.contract: Same solved row: same place/location, clock or known connected interval, angle, passage/legacy explicit limb, height, uncertainty and selected real position. NOTES retains day/body/target context and geometric-model notice; Explore retains selected-day refracted conditions. Missing interval or disc geometry is never inferred. Label/render work must not call a numerical solver. Purpose-equivalent independent implementations must be searched before changing this component; direct-call and wording checks are not complete feature discovery. The legacy picker retains its four-column filter header and receives already projected labels/angle/height after eligibility filtering; raw solver rows must not overwrite that projection. Whole-object tower passage uses named projected parts shared with position choices; buildings use height regions; mountains and explicit legacy limbs retain their meaning. Recorded ground-road classification uses cached GSI centreline/edge containment after first paint, rejects roofs/water/elevated points, and changes display only. Missing facility kinds are supplemented from complete bundled OSM polygons/holes or exact viewpoint nodes before road fallback, without name inference or nearby-node borrowing; failures remain retryable. Context updates the same row after first paint and is shared by every recorded-candidate surface.

terms: 全体の中央付近を通過

components.name: 地点の自動名と住所
surfaces: 地図/座標/現在地の地点選択
components.contract: One nearby lookup policy: keep facility names; use street/kaido aliases or numbered national/prefectural roads when supplied; otherwise use available address. Do not guess fame, borrow adjacent street names, overwrite explicit saved names, or classify a line as road. Cache successful lookups; preserve caller cancellation and draft identity.

components.name: 候補一覧の角度と方向記号
surfaces: 記録地点詳細の線/範囲候補
components.contract: One rounded value determines the existing signed numeric table or elevation/depression/horizontal label and the B direction glyph. Rounded zero, including negative zero, is horizontal; unknown angles have no glyph. The UI_ICONS SVG constants are injected once through configure; the same row, text span and SVG survive same-direction rerenders. Icons are decorative, and the accessible label explains above/below horizontal. No ephemeris, terrain IO, saved fields or extra search. The legacy four-column header and rows share the wider angle column. Map bearing/elevation readouts retain their separate precision and purpose. A reused row takes its compact/numeric presentation from the actual existing row DOM, not a later host mode; register/apply and late context must not switch its label or unknown visibility. The composite angle has a named img role; its SVG is decorative.

components.name: 撮影地点の高さ入力
components.contract: 標高と地上高の範囲、入力の確定・復元、エラー表示を共通にする。自動値への復帰と旧データ、計算と保存は各画面が所有。
